recent_text_gradients: Round 5, combination_jump: Add a causal prefix-length input feature and jointly tune history length, convolution depth, dropout and learning rate. Retain one NextItNet checkpoint per category, existing scoring and pointwise loss, routing, splits, seeds and training limits. The generated predictor imports the updated architecture and loads its projection weights.; validation=0.55, delta_vs_input=-0.0062, outcome=regressed, promoted=True, GPU seconds=347.8. An observation of this exact configuration, not a rule against the whole direction.

Round 5, combination_jump: Coordinate training-only frequency projections, second-convolution causal GLUs, and a shorter six-block configuration across all four category models. Preserve pointwise loss, tied candidate embeddings, final-real-position readout and one checkpoint per category. Predictor compatibility follows its existing import of the updated model class.; validation=0.5425, delta_vs_input=-0.0137, outcome=regressed, promoted=False, GPU seconds=527.9. An observation of this exact configuration, not a rule against the whole direction.

Round 5, combination_jump: Coordinate training-only causal frequency features, fixed-scale tied embeddings, learned bilinear compatibility and a shorter four-block NextItNet configuration across all four category models. Preserve routing, splits, seeds, loss, training caps and single-checkpoint prediction.; validation=0.505, delta_vs_input=-0.0512, outcome=regressed, promoted=False, GPU seconds=310.3. An observation of this exact configuration, not a rule against the whole direction.

Round 5, combination_jump: Add causal relative-frequency input features and context-dependent residual gates across all four category models, with checkpoint-consistent prediction. Preserve NextItNet, one checkpoint per category, routing, splits, seeds, loss and training caps.; validation=0.5375, delta_vs_input=-0.0187, outcome=regressed, promoted=False, GPU seconds=507.4. An observation of this exact configuration, not a rule against the whole direction.

Round 6, hyperparameter_tuning: Jointly tune NextItNet to eight blocks, dropout 0.2 and learning rate 1e-3 across all four category models. Existing metadata keeps prediction checkpoint-compatible. Require GAGC_DATA_DIR.; validation=0.5463, delta_vs_input=-0.0037, outcome=regressed, promoted=False, GPU seconds=584.7. An observation of this exact configuration, not a rule against the whole direction.

Round 6, sequence_interest: Index positions by observed-prefix length consistently in training and imported inference architecture. Preserve model shapes, history length, features, scoring, loss, optimizer and category routing; require the host-supplied data directory.; validation=0.5225, delta_vs_input=-0.0275, outcome=regressed, promoted=False, GPU seconds=448.8. An observation of this exact configuration, not a rule against the whole direction.

Round 6, feature_construction: Add checkpoint-backed, training-only frequency attenuation to historical inputs across all four category models. Preserve predictor compatibility, one checkpoint per category and existing training settings.; validation=0.5537, delta_vs_input=0.0037, outcome=improved, promoted=True, GPU seconds=554.3. An observation of this exact configuration, not a rule against the whole direction.

Round 6, learning_objective: Apply equal-sequence weighting to the existing logistic objective across all four category models and enforce GAGC_DATA_DIR. Predictor and checkpoint shapes remain unchanged.; validation=0.5262, delta_vs_input=-0.0238, outcome=regressed, promoted=False, GPU seconds=521.8. An observation of this exact configuration, not a rule against the whole direction.
